title: Currywurst Satay with Braised Cabbage
description: A twist on traditional German Currywurst, this recipe combines the flavors of Malaysia with the heartiness of Germany. A tender and flavorful currywurst served with a side of slow-cooked cabbage.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together curry paste and 2 tbsp water to make a paste.
Brush the curry paste onto the satay, making sure to coat evenly.
Grill the satay for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
While the satay is cooking, heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped cabbage to the pan and cook for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until tender and caramelized.
Season the cabbage with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the currywurst satay with a side of braised cabbage and garnish with chopped peanuts and crispy shallots, if desired.
